NDT software in Texas City: large refineries, chemicals and a working port

NDT software for Texas City inspection companies has to support long turnarounds at very large refineries, chemical plant work and marine jobs at the port. The Atlantis ERP solution gives Texas City NDT companies one system for technician certifications, instrument calibration, crew dispatch, NDT reports, quotes and invoices, set up around the way you work on the Galveston Bay side of the region.

Texas City is home to Marathon Petroleum's Galveston Bay refinery, one of the largest refineries in the United States and the city's largest employer, which absorbed the former BP Texas City refinery. Valero operates its Texas City refinery alongside it. Eastman Chemical, Dow and INEOS run chemical operations nearby, and together these sites make up the largest industrial tax base in Galveston County. The Port of Texas City handles liquid bulk and barge traffic, and the shipyards and offshore support activity around Galveston are a short drive away.

Texas City's industrial history shapes how clients think about safety. The 1947 Texas City disaster and the 2005 BP isomerization unit explosion, investigated by the U.S. Chemical Safety Board, led to lasting changes in process safety practice, including industry guidance on fatigue risk management for workers on long shifts. OSHA process safety management drives mechanical integrity, TCEQ monitors emissions events, and hurricanes, including Ike in 2008, are part of local memory. Typical Texas City contractors run large turnaround crews working extended shifts in spring and fall, plus smaller marine and chemical plant jobs in between.

ERP for NDT companies in Texas City: turnarounds at scale

An ERP for NDT companies in Texas City needs to handle turnarounds at a scale few other towns see. A refinery turnaround may bring dozens of NDT technicians on site across several units, working day and night shifts for weeks. Every tech needs checked certifications, every instrument needs current calibration, every report needs approval and every hour needs to be billed correctly.

The Atlantis ERP keeps that in one system. Jobs created from accepted quotations carry client PO, contract, site, methods, codes, scope and acceptance criteria. Team assignments block double-booking of technicians and equipment serials. Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup time with billable flag and rate multiplier and go through approval. Reports and invoices point back to the same job.

For a Texas City contractor, this means the turnaround manager can answer the client's daily questions about headcount, reports issued and hours billed from one place rather than from three spreadsheets and a phone. See all apps at Atlantis ERP apps.

Timesheets and hours control for long Texas City turnaround shifts

Timesheet software for Texas City turnarounds should give you a reliable record of who worked how long, on what and where. The Timesheets app records work type, method, billable flag, rate multiplier, site, client and equipment serial, with approval. It also warns if the technician's certificate is not valid.

Texas City clients take fatigue seriously because of local history, and many refinery contracts set limits on consecutive shifts and hours. The ERP does not decide those limits for you, but its timesheet data gives you the hours record to check against your client's rules, and hour-limit reports or alerts can be configured during implementation. Time Off feeds the technician availability calendar, so rest days show up before the dispatcher assigns the next shift.

Accurate timesheets also protect revenue. Night shift, standby waiting for permits and overtime all carry different billing treatment, and the rate multiplier and work type on each line mean the invoice reflects what the crew actually did. Expenses such as per diems and travel can be logged and re-billed to the job.

Technician certification tracking for Texas City refinery crews

Technician certification tracking software for Texas City must work at turnaround speed. The Certificates app records scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam passed and attachments.

Status is calculated as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked. Warning tasks appear 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires, and configurable email alerts go to the turnaround manager and Level III. Vision tests record near vision at Jaeger J1 or J2, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic and expiry. The employee NDT profile holds highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry.

When a large Texas City turnaround is a month away, you can filter for every tech on the planned roster whose cert or vision test will lapse before demobilisation, not just before mobilisation. That stops the mid-turnaround scramble when a PAUT tech's cert expires in week three. Company certifications such as ISO accreditations are tracked with alert days for prequalification packages.

Marine NDT reporting for the Port of Texas City and Galveston

Marine NDT reporting in Texas City needs class society paperwork, not just a results table. The NDT Reports app has a marine mode with a vessel cover page and photo, inspection location and dates, and inspection photos in a 2-up grid.

The PDF merges the classification society certificate from a library covering DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, BV, RINA, IRS and ClassNK, the inspector's Level II certificate and the calibration certificate for the instrument used. That makes one package a surveyor can accept without asking for separate attachments.

For UT thickness gauging on barges and vessels at Texas City docks or in Galveston shipyards, UT thickness reports record readings by direction. Weld repairs can be covered with MT, PT, UT and VT reports carrying defect type and orientation. The offline field app works aboard a vessel or in a hold with no signal, captures photos and signatures, and syncs when the tech is back on shore.

NDT reporting software for Texas City refinery and chemical work

NDT reporting software for Texas City refineries and chemical plants needs to cover all the methods a large turnaround calls for. The Atlantis ERP has 17 report types, including UT, RT, computed radiography, MT, PT, VT, PAUT, TOFD, ECT, IRIS, MFL, PMI, hardness, PWHT, UT thickness, ferrite and holiday or coating, each with its own numbering sequence.

Reports record work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers, procedure and standard references, and move from draft through in progress, review, approved and sent. Inspector, reviewer and approver signatures are captured, plus a third-party or authorized inspector name and signature. Large refineries usually require their own templates, so versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML are built during implementation, with Excel templates filled automatically.

For clients who want inspection results shown on a 3D model of the unit, reports can feed Digital Twin Reporting and Atlantis Digital Twins, which map indications and show thickness and remaining-life trends visually.

Crew dispatch software for Texas City: refinery, chemical and port jobs

Crew dispatch software for Texas City has to manage a big turnaround roster while still covering smaller port and chemical plant calls. The Team Assignments app runs jobs through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates.

The availability calendar blocks overlapping assignments, leave, training and sick days. Technicians and equipment serials cannot be double-booked, and out-of-calibration equipment triggers a warning. Utilisation, current assignment and next available date are shown for each technician in calendar, kanban and list views.

Many Texas City crews commute from League City, Galveston or Houston's southern suburbs, and the Fleet app assigns vehicles to projects and drivers with dates and mileage. Radiography vehicles are flagged for radioactive source transport with licence number and expiry. When a hurricane threatens Galveston Bay, the dispatcher can see every crew and every vehicle committed in the area and plan demobilisation.

Calibration management software for Texas City turnaround instrument pools

Calibration management software for Texas City must handle an instrument pool that swells for turnarounds. The Asset Management app tracks each instrument and probe by serial number with type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle status, including rented out. Rental rates can be recorded for instruments you rent in or out.

Calibration records include provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited lab flag, result and next due date. The certificate register tracks lab accreditation numbers and PDFs with expiry alerts. Reservations prevent clashes, and inbound and outbound movements are logged.

At the end of a large turnaround, the issue and return workflow with supervisor and manager approval, and condition recorded at return, shows which instruments came back damaged and which are still out. Dashboards show calibrations due or overdue and issued equipment overdue for return.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Texas City contracts

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Texas City has to price large turnaround packages and bill them accurately. The Quotations app records job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with services flagged by method and category, a global discount, a branded PDF and online acceptance and signature.

The Invoicing app carries NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals. Lines include cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over twelve months. Integration with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections runs through the open REST API, scoped per implementation.

What to ask in an NDT ERP demo if your crews work Texas City

Texas City work is shaped by large refinery and chemical sites that run long turnarounds and hold contractors to strict audits. The questions below come straight from that pattern, and a vendor should be able to answer each one on screen rather than in a slide.

  • Show the certificate, vision exam and site training history of every technician on a turnaround crew, in one view an auditor for the owner could read.
  • Show which calibration blocks and instruments are at the Texas City site today and which are back at the shop.
  • Show standby time, overtime and per diem entered in the field and carried onto the invoice without retyping.
  • Show a report revised after the client review, with the earlier version kept and the change recorded.
  • Show the dashboard an owner-manager would open on Monday morning to see open jobs, unbilled hours and expiring certificates.

Answers like these separate an NDT-specific system from a general ERP with a few renamed fields. Book a walkthrough and bring your list.

Frequently asked questions

What NDT software works for large Texas City refinery turnarounds?

Software that checks certifications, blocks double-booking, tracks calibration and bills from approved timesheets. The Atlantis ERP does all of these in one system.

Can it produce marine reports with class society certificates?

Yes. Marine mode merges the class society certificate, the inspector's Level II cert and the calibration certificate into the report PDF.

Does it help with fatigue and hours limits?

It records approved timesheet hours by technician, shift and work type. Hour-limit reports or alerts matching your client's rules can be configured during implementation.

Is it affordable for a small NDT company in Texas City?

Yes. It is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, with pricing as a quote on request.

Does the field app work on a vessel or inside a unit with no signal?

Yes. The offline app stores drafts and photos locally and syncs later.

How do we get a demo?

Contact us for a demo using your methods and report formats.
